Production-signed updater 1.0.87 is the qualified configured-node update path. Its authenticated target, preservation, rollback and sampled RF-health gates remain mandatory. No new updater, receiver-specific build, trust policy or private driver patch is introduced.

This immutable application asset supports an authorized existing configured Airspy node update. It does not qualify a new complete installer, registered-empty update, public download-card change, stable pointer, every receiver or RF band. Those publication and physical qualification gates remain separate.
